summary_en: On November 17, 2026, the board authorized a share buyback of up to 30,000 shares (0.37% of outstanding shares) at the closing price of 428 yen per share, for a maximum aggregate amount of 12.84 million yen. The purchase will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 on November 18, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 17, 2026, Ichishin Holdings' board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 30,000 treasury shares on a fixed-price basis via off-hours trading (ToSTNeT-3). The purchase price is set at 428 yen per share, the closing price on November 17, 2026, with a maximum aggregate expenditure of 12.84 million yen. This represents 0.37% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), calculated on the basis of 8,162,095 outstanding shares as of August 31, 2026.

The execution is scheduled for November 18, 2026, beginning at 8:45 a.m. Tokyo time, with results to be announced upon conclusion of the trading session. The buy order is limited to that specific trading window only. The company stated the purpose as enabling flexible execution of capital policy in response to changes in the management environment. Market conditions may result in partial or complete non-execution of the authorized purchase.
